overview_description.description:
Nexthink is a global leader in digital experience management. 

The company's product allows enterprises to create highly productive digital workplaces for their employees by delivering optimal end-user experience. Through a unique combination of real-time analytics, automation and employee feedback across all endpoints, Nexthink helps IT teams meet the needs of the modern digital workplace.

about_short_description.short_description: Nexthink is a software company that assists enterprises create digital workplaces for their employees by using Agentic-AI and IT.

product.name: Nexthink Infinity Platform
product.description: A digital employee experience (DEX) management platform that combines workforce technology observability, experience data, analytics, automation, and AI-powered IT agents.

product.name: Nexthink Workplace Experience
product.description: A DEX management capability for monitoring devices, networks, applications, and employee feedback to identify and resolve digital workplace issues.

product.name: Nexthink Workspace
product.description: An AI-powered workspace for IT teams to analyze DEX data, make operational decisions, design actions, and automate digital workplace management.

product.name: Nexthink Spark
product.description: An employee-facing AI IT agent that provides conversational assistance and can help resolve common technology issues directly in the employee workflow.

product.name: Nexthink Flow
product.description: An automation capability for creating workflows that streamline IT operations, remediate issues, and improve service desk and workplace processes.

product.name: Nexthink Application Experience
product.description: A monitoring and optimization capability for understanding application performance, availability, usage, and its effect on employee experience.
